description:
Implement the graph/workspace views that explain how swarm-manager works and what is happening right now.

This work should:
- build lifecycle/flow views for capture classification, backlog refinement, finalize, queue, execution, follow-up, and archive paths
- make prompts and agent usage visible as step-level drilldowns instead of primary navigation
- add operations overlays or lenses for active runs, blocked work, aging items, throughput, and other bottleneck signals
- ensure the reference/explainer surfaces and live operations surfaces share the same underlying flow model where appropriate
- keep the default experience calm and readable; avoid turning the canvas into constant animation noise

This item should make swarm-manager legible both as a system model and as an operator dashboard.
name: swarm-manager-flow-and-ops-views
title: Build Lifecycle, Flow, and Operations Views in the Graph Workspace
